This report regenerates the forest, violin, and Hühnerberg dose-response plots
using the saved CmdStan model fits and the integrated dataset. 

## 1. Load packages, data, and saved model fits

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(posterior)
library(here)
library(stringr)

integrated_file <- here::here(
  "outputs",
  "integrated_geochemistry_for_bayesian.csv"
)

model_dir <- here::here(
  "outputs",
  "Bayesian_treatment_comparisons",
  "models"
)

plot_dir <- here::here(
  "outputs",
  "Bayesian_treatment_comparisons",
  "plots"
)

dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(integrated_file)) {
  stop("Integrated data file not found: ", integrated_file)
}

if (!dir.exists(model_dir)) {
  stop("Saved model directory not found: ", model_dir)
}

integrated <- read_csv(
  integrated_file,
  na = c("", "NA", "#VALUE!"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

treatment_levels <- c("Control", "Lime", "HB 50", "EG 50", "BD 50")

treatment_data <- integrated %>%
  filter(
    Treatment == "Control" |
      grepl("^Lime", Treatment) |
      Treatment %in% c(
        "Huhnerberg_50",
        "Eifelgold_50",
        "Bolsdorfer_50"
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment_PCA = case_when(
      Treatment == "Control" ~ "Control",
      grepl("^Lime", Treatment) ~ "Lime",
      Treatment == "Huhnerberg_50" ~ "HB 50",
      Treatment == "Eifelgold_50" ~ "EG 50",
      Treatment == "Bolsdorfer_50" ~ "BD 50",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Treatment_PCA = factor(
      Treatment_PCA,
      levels = treatment_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment_PCA))

parameter_categories <- list(
  "Soil_Chemistry" = c("soil_pH", "soil_EC"),

  "CEC_Cations" = c(
    "CEC_CEC", "CEC_Base_saturation", "CEC_H",
    "CEC_Ca", "CEC_K", "CEC_Mg", "CEC_Na",
    "CEC_Al", "CEC_Fe", "CEC_Mn"
  ),

  "Oxalate_Pools_Ratios" = c(
    "Fe_ox_over_DCB", "Al_ox_over_DCB",
    "Mn_ox_over_DCB", "Si_ox_over_DCB",
    "Fe_ox_over_Si_ox", "Al_ox_over_Si_ox"
  ),

  "Tessier_Carbonate" = c(
    "Tessier_Acetic_Ca_mg_g",
    "Tessier_Acetic_K_mg_g",
    "Tessier_Acetic_Na_mg_g",
    "Tessier_Acetic_Mg_mg_g"
  ),

  "Tessier_Exchangeable" = c(
    "Tessier_NH4OAc_Ca_mg_g",
    "Tessier_NH4OAc_K_mg_g",
    "Tessier_NH4OAc_Na_mg_g",
    "Tessier_NH4OAc_Mg_mg_g"
  ),

  "Tessier_Oxidizable" = c(
    "Tessier_H2O2_Fe_mg_g",
    "Tessier_H2O2_Al_mg_g",
    "Tessier_H2O2_Mn_mg_g",
    "Tessier_H2O2_Si_mg_g"
  ),

  "Tessier_Reducible" = c(
    "Tessier_Hydroxylamine_Fe_mg_g",
    "Tessier_Hydroxylamine_Al_mg_g",
    "Tessier_Hydroxylamine_Mn_mg_g",
    "Tessier_Hydroxylamine_Si_mg_g"
  ),

  "Aggregate_Stability" = c(
    "GMD_h2o", "D_h2o", "MWD_h2o",
    "GMD_oxalate_over_h2o",
    "D_oxalate_over_h2o",
    "MWD_oxalate_over_h2o"
  ),

  "FTIR_Spectral" = c(
    "FTIR_delta_aromatic",
    "FTIR_delta_Carbonate_bend",
    "FTIR_delta_carbonate_stretch",
    "FTIR_delta_carbonyl",
    "FTIR_delta_Aliphatic_total",
    "FTIR_delta_COO_total",
    "FTIR_delta_polysaccharide",
    "FTIR_delta_poorly_crystalline",
    "FTIR_delta_Silicate",
    "FTIR_delta_total_area"
  ),

  "Carbon_Stocks" = c(
    "C_Bulk", "C_MAOM", "C_oPOM", "C_fPOM"
  ),

  "Radiocarbon_Signatures" = c(
    "d14C_2026_Bulk",
    "d14C_2026_MAOM",
    "d14C_2026_oPOM",
    "d14C_2026_fPOM"
  )
)

available_parameters <- intersect(
  unname(unlist(parameter_categories)),
  names(treatment_data)
)

# Locate and load the saved CmdStan fit for each response variable.
model_files <- list.files(
  model_dir,
  pattern = "_Bayesian_treatment_model\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

model_files <- model_files[
  file.exists(model_files)
]

model_fits <- setNames(
  lapply(model_files, readRDS),
  str_remove(
    basename(model_files),
    "_Bayesian_treatment_model\\.rds$"
  )
)

cat("Saved model fits loaded:", length(model_fits), "\n")
cat("Responses available in integrated dataset:", length(available_parameters), "\n")
```

## 2. Reconstruct posterior treatment contrasts from saved fits

The original model standardized each response using its mean and standard
deviation across the observations included in that response's model. This
section reconstructs the posterior treatment means and primary treatment-minus-
Control contrasts from each stored fit's `mu` draws.

```{r}
primary_pairs <- tibble(
  Treatment_1 = c("Lime", "HB 50", "EG 50", "BD 50"),
  Treatment_2 = "Control"
) %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = paste(Treatment_1, "minus", Treatment_2)
  )

posterior_primary_contrasts <- list()

for (response in available_parameters) {

  if (!response %in% names(model_fits)) {
    message("No saved model fit for response: ", response)
    next
  }

  response_data <- treatment_data %>%
    select(Treatment_PCA, all_of(response)) %>%
    rename(Value = all_of(response)) %>%
    drop_na(Value, Treatment_PCA) %>%
    mutate(
      Treatment_PCA = factor(
        Treatment_PCA,
        levels = treatment_levels
      )
    )

  # Must match the data rows used to fit the original response model.
  if (n_distinct(response_data$Treatment_PCA) != 5) {
    message("Skipping ", response, ": not all 5 treatment groups are present.")
    next
  }

  response_sd <- sd(response_data$Value)

  if (!is.finite(response_sd) || response_sd == 0) {
    message("Skipping ", response, ": response SD is zero or invalid.")
    next
  }

  fit <- model_fits[[response]]

  mu_draws <- posterior::as_draws_matrix(
    fit$draws(variables = "mu")
  )

  # CmdStan mu index order follows treatment_levels.
  mu_matrix <- do.call(
    cbind,
    lapply(seq_along(treatment_levels), function(k) {
      mu_draws[, paste0("mu[", k, "]")]
    })
  )

  colnames(mu_matrix) <- treatment_levels

  response_contrasts <- map_dfr(
    seq_len(nrow(primary_pairs)),
    function(i) {

      t1 <- primary_pairs$Treatment_1[i]
      t2 <- primary_pairs$Treatment_2[i]

      difference_z <- mu_matrix[, t1] - mu_matrix[, t2]

      tibble(
        Response = response,
        Treatment_1 = t1,
        Treatment_2 = t2,
        Comparison = paste(t1, "minus", t2),
        Difference_standardized = mean(difference_z),
        Lower_95_standardized = unname(
          quantile(difference_z, 0.025)
        ),
        Upper_95_standardized = unname(
          quantile(difference_z, 0.975)
        ),
        Difference_original = mean(difference_z) * response_sd,
        Lower_95_original = unname(
          quantile(difference_z, 0.025) * response_sd
        ),
        Upper_95_original = unname(
          quantile(difference_z, 0.975) * response_sd
        ),
        Probability_Treatment1_higher = mean(difference_z > 0),
        Probability_Treatment1_lower = mean(difference_z < 0)
      )
    }
  )

  posterior_primary_contrasts[[response]] <- response_contrasts
}

primary_contrasts_all <- bind_rows(
  posterior_primary_contrasts
)

if (nrow(primary_contrasts_all) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No primary contrasts were reconstructed. ",
    "Check the saved model filenames and integrated dataset."
  )
}

primary_contrasts_all <- primary_contrasts_all %>%
  mutate(
    Category = names(parameter_categories)[
      match(
        Response,
        unlist(parameter_categories)
      )
    ]
  )

write_csv(
  primary_contrasts_all,
  file.path(
    plot_dir,
    "Regenerated_Bayesian_primary_contrasts.csv"
  )
)
```

## 3. Primary forest plots (standardized units)

These use the same plot structure as the original script: treatment contrasts
versus Control, 95% credible intervals, no significance stars.

```{r}
for (cat_name in names(parameter_categories)) {

  cat_data <- primary_contrasts_all %>%
    filter(Category == cat_name)

  if (nrow(cat_data) == 0) next

  p_forest <- ggplot(
    cat_data,
    aes(
      x = Difference_standardized,
      y = Response,
      color = Comparison
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "gray50"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      size = 2
    ) +
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(
        xmin = Lower_95_standardized,
        xmax = Upper_95_standardized
      ),
      height = 0.2,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Primary Treatment Contrasts (vs Control) -",
        cat_name
      ),
      subtitle = "Differences in Standardized Units (95% Credible Intervals)",
      x = "Standardized Difference minus Control (SD Units)",
      y = "Parameter"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      plot_dir,
      paste0(
        "Primary_Forest_Plot_Standardized_",
        cat_name,
        ".png"
      )
    ),
    plot = p_forest,
    width = 9,
    height = max(4, length(unique(cat_data$Response)) * 0.6),
    dpi = 300
  )

  print(p_forest)
}
```

## 4. Violin plots grouped by parameter category

```{r}
raw_data_categorized <- treatment_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = any_of(available_parameters),
    names_to = "Response",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Value) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = names(parameter_categories)[
      match(
        Response,
        unlist(parameter_categories)
      )
    ]
  )

for (cat_name in names(parameter_categories)) {

  cat_raw <- raw_data_categorized %>%
    filter(Category == cat_name)

  if (nrow(cat_raw) == 0) next

  p_violin <- ggplot(
    cat_raw,
    aes(
      x = Treatment_PCA,
      y = Value,
      fill = Treatment_PCA
    )
  ) +
    geom_violin(
      alpha = 0.6,
      trim = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.1,
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.8,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Response,
      scales = "free_y"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Treatment Distribution (Violin Plots) -",
        cat_name
      ),
      x = "Treatment",
      y = "Measured Value"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 30,
        hjust = 1
      )
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      plot_dir,
      paste0(
        "Violin_Plots_",
        cat_name,
        ".png"
      )
    ),
    plot = p_violin,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )

  print(p_violin)
}
```

## 5. Hühnerberg dose-response plots

```{r}
hb_dose_data <- integrated %>%
  filter(
    Treatment == "Control" |
      grepl("^Huhnerberg", Treatment) |
      grepl("^HB_", Treatment) |
      grepl("^HB[0-9]", Treatment)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Dose_t_ha = case_when(
      Treatment == "Control" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(
        gsub("[^0-9]", "", Treatment)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Dose_t_ha)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = any_of(available_parameters),
    names_to = "Response",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Value) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = names(parameter_categories)[
      match(
        Response,
        unlist(parameter_categories)
      )
    ]
  )

for (cat_name in names(parameter_categories)) {

  cat_hb <- hb_dose_data %>%
    filter(Category == cat_name)

  if (nrow(cat_hb) == 0) next

  p_dose_hb <- ggplot(
    cat_hb,
    aes(
      x = Dose_t_ha,
      y = Value
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(
      color = "darkblue",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
      color = "darkblue",
      size = 2.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Response,
      scales = "free_y"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Hühnerberg Dose-Response Trends -",
        cat_name
      ),
      subtitle = "Application Rates (0, 10, 20, 50, 100 t/ha)",
      x = "Hühnerberg Application Rate (t/ha)",
      y = "Measured Parameter Value"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = sort(unique(cat_hb$Dose_t_ha))
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      plot_dir,
      paste0(
        "Huhnerberg_Dose_Response_",
        cat_name,
        ".png"
      )
    ),
    plot = p_dose_hb,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )

  print(p_dose_hb)
}
```
